entities.summary: Enny Manuel Romero Hernandez is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher for the Toros de Tijuana of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Tampa Bay Rays, Washington Nationals, Pittsburgh Pirates, and Kansas City Royals, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chunichi Dragons.
